# PostForm

> Free LinkedIn text formatter. Convert ChatGPT or Gemini Markdown into LinkedIn-ready Unicode bold, italic, and monospace — with live preview and paste-safe paragraph spacing.

PostForm runs entirely in the browser. No account. No upload. No API keys.

## Product

- Name: PostForm
- Category: LinkedIn text formatter / Unicode font generator for social posts
- URL: /

## What it does

LinkedIn posts do not support Markdown or rich text. Asterisks from AI drafts show as literal characters. PostForm converts:

- `**bold**` / `__bold__` → Mathematical Sans-Serif Bold Unicode
- `*italic*` / `_italic_` → Mathematical Sans-Serif Italic Unicode
- `` `code` `` → Mathematical Monospace Unicode

It also preserves blank lines when pasting into LinkedIn (empty lines are collapsed by LinkedIn unless padded with an invisible spacer).

## Features

- Side-by-side Markdown editor and LinkedIn-style feed preview
- Style toolbar: bold, italic, bold italic, mono, script, small caps, strikethrough
- Insert: horizontal divider, code, bullet, check, arrow
- Keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+B, I, E, Shift+X, Shift+H, backtick, …)
- UTF-16 character counter against LinkedIn’s ~3,000 limit
- Copy for LinkedIn button

## Who it is for

Creators, engineers, and marketers who draft LinkedIn posts in ChatGPT, Gemini, or other AI tools and need formatting that survives paste into the LinkedIn composer.

## Privacy

All conversion happens client-side. Content is not sent to a server.
